scope: P3-04 provenance-checked incremental plan submission and safe reuse, with P3 stage documentation and startup instructions.

Node requirements, dependency identities/hashes/Producer/versions, model/policy/output tool versions, fresh verdicts and actual CAS bytes are all checked before adoption. Reuse does not reset/refund delegation budget. Four migrations apply append-only.

The deterministic trusted API refuses Runs with active claimed/executing/output_ready/verifying instances. Autonomous dynamic replanning and active-execution handoff remain P4; no such behavior is claimed here.

Actual audit failures reproduced forged Claim NodeKey bypasses of model/tool configuration checks. Both were fixed by resolving the node from its database Task association; red/green logs are retained.

An initial integration assertion expected a one-step Workflow finalization; it was corrected to assert the already-frozen running->verifying->succeeded protocol. No production transition was changed for that test.

Synthetic trusted Verdict fixtures support protocol tests; no independent P5 Verifier, hostile-code Sandbox or complete Capability Gateway is claimed. Autonomous Go/Python Worker dispatch/renewal/result integration remains absent.

No paid model requests or production database operations. Cloud startup draft saved but requires review/save/publish in environment settings; fresh-task local-only commit restoration remains unverified.
